race.comment: ALL MOONLITE (9) is a lightly tried 6YO mare who has raced her way into form with a step up to this sort of distance, finishing runner-up in her last couple of outings. She raced handy to the pace last start at Hamilton, and stuck on gamely, and her first win is not far away. EFREETI (3) has hit the line with purpose in each of his 2 starts to date, and the step up from 1600m to 2200m is exactly what he is looking for. If he is strong enough to cope with the trip, then he will go close to taking it out. ASHINA (10) ran on late for second at Moe in his penultimate start over 2050m, and then stuck to her guns bravely for another second at Ballarat over 2648m. She won't lack fitness, and could grind out a win here. ATEYATE (2) is a touch one-paced and he will relish getting out to this trip fifth up from a spell. Dean Yendall picking up the ride is a strong lead from the stable, and he has each-way claims again. EMPRESS OF CHINA (12) usually whacks away in her races. Include.
